description: Nichtöffentliches Abwasser is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Data on non-public wastewater disposal are collected on the basis of the Environmental Statistics Act (UStatG), last amended on 16.8.2005 (§8). Part of the reporting group includes the thermal power plants that generate electricity for the public supply by using the thermal energy of fuels or other energy sources to generate electrical energy. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Non-public waste water" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
